description: This file defines a utility enum DurationFormattingSupport with a static method to format durations in milliseconds into a concise human-readable string. It provides logic for converting milliseconds into seconds, minutes, hours, and days with appropriate rounding and labels.

methods.name: conciseDuration
methods.description: Converts an integer duration in milliseconds into a concise string representation, such as '500ms', '30s', '2m', '3h', or '5d'.
